Source: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/eba561bf883c3645dff709a4acc3690960732f47

Coverage: Actual diff inspected; related inverse/reland duplicate hunks checked as a chain.
Full Python diff reconstructs gecko_strings per-locale repo/revision map from self.l10n_revisions after upstream field removal. comm_strings retains shared repository/revision. Review asks validation of both strings_all.tar.zst and l10n-changesets.json using manually added L10n-pre jobs, not simply job success.

commit eba561bf883c3645dff709a4acc3690960732f47
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jun 4 22:00:00 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jun 4 22:00:00 2024 +0000

    Bug 1900576 - Port bug 1881272: Refactor desktop_comm_l10n after upstream changes to support Git. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D212552

diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/desktop_comm_l10n.py b/taskcluster/scripts/desktop_comm_l10n.py
index ae395e50d1b..1c7af38c2f3 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/desktop_comm_l10n.py
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/desktop_comm_l10n.py
@@ -213,8 +213,16 @@ class CommMultiLocale(LocalesMixin, AutomationMixin, VCSMixin, BaseScript):
                 create_tar_from_files(z, dict(self.file_registry))
 
     def gen_changesets(self):
+        # self.l10n_revisions has the gecko string revs
+        gecko_l10n_revisions = {}
+        for l in self.locales:
+            gecko_l10n_revisions[l] = {
+                "repo": f"{self.config['hg_l10n_base']}/{l}",
+                "revision": self.l10n_revisions[l],
+            }
+
         changeset_data = {
-            "gecko_strings": self.gecko_locale_revisions,
+            "gecko_strings": gecko_l10n_revisions,
             "comm_strings": {
                 "repo": self.config["hg_comm_l10n_repo"],
                 "revision": self.comm_l10n_revision,
